meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 为容器安装 mnemon 记忆组件,并在每次容器启动时注册 Claude Code hooks:回复前自动调出相关历史记忆,每轮结束后写入新见解。记忆存在 .claude 挂载目录中,容器重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 只对运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent group 生效(container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude);换成其他 provider 时 hooks 不会运行。安装后每次容器启动自动执行。

say.text: 把 mnemon 装进容器镜像里
say.note: 会在 Dockerfile 插入安装层并重建镜像

say.text: 确认 mnemon hooks 有没有注册成功
上次我们聊的那个方案,还记得吗?
say.note: 新会话里 mnemon 应自动调出该上下文

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon into the container image and registers Claude Code hooks on each container start: relevant past context is surfaced before the agent responds, and new insights are stored after each turn. Memory lives in the .claude/ mount and survives restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies only to agent groups running the default Claude provider (provider key absent or "claude" in container.json); other providers never run the hooks. Setup runs automatically on each container start.

say_en.text: Install mnemon into the container image.
say_en.note: Adds the Dockerfile layer and rebuilds.

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered.
Do you remember the plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: New session should recall that context automatically.
